events.text: older versions kept beside a newer one aren't outdated
nixpkgs-update logs read anew: a failed request is an update failure
versions ordered as Repology orders them: a pre-release before its release
GitHub releases checked for every package fetched from GitHub: newer ones Repology hasn't seen count as outdated
kept series: coq's aren't devel variants, and a release kept only beside its own beta (firefox) counts as the main line
kept series behind in their own series count as outdated (glibmm_2_4 2.66.8, 2.66.10 out)
one distribution's snapshot of a release isn't a newer version (mintotp 0.3.0, SlackBuilds' 0.3.0.20240120)
